0022600040.text: The San Antonio Spurs (10-2, 4-2 at home, on a 10-game winning streak) host the Golden State Warriors (8-4, 2-3 on the road, on an 8-2 run over their last ten) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, with the Spurs sitting 1st in the Southwest and 2nd in the West and the Warriors 6th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Pacific. Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain) are out for the Spurs, and Devin Vassell (groin) is day-to-day and a game-time decision; for the Warriors, Brandon Williams (hamstring), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery) are out, while Gary Payton II (knee inflammation) and Stephen Curry (abdominal soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 and have not played yet in 2026-27, and the Spurs won their last meeting 127-113 in San Francisco on April 1, 2026.
